purpose: Inline text link with an arrow that slides in on hover (the feature-callout "Learn more" pattern) - also the accent link inside body copy of benefit cards (e.g. a 3-word inline link).

label.note: Measured: "Learn more" (2 words); inline links in codapay benefit copy are 3 words.

href.note: One of the 15 route paths or "#".

states.hover: arrow width 0 -> 1.2em, opacity 0 -> 1, 300ms; when the whole card is .group-hovered the link radius becomes lg

motion.reducedMotionFallback: Design rule: show the arrow statically or not at all; do not animate width.

responsive.note: No breakpoint-specific rule found in the CSS for this link; behaviour is hover-only (no hover on touch).

evidence.structure: structure measured against live coda.co (~1px, CLONE_SPEC.md); no copy in this contract
